_about: What each WEB-xxx request would look like as a real perennialsfabrics.com submission: 'Add Sample To Cart' on a product page adds an exact colorway (variant SKU) with a Project Type (residential | hospitality, optional), and checkout carries Project Name and an order note. The note is the original free-text message from the workbook. Where the message asked for 'everything' / 'all your solids' / 'every color of X', the cart lists the SKUs that implies.
